title: Technical diagrams / Large node — Color block

location.series: IBM Design Language / alternate tab states
location.label: Color block node

slide_intent: Separate an icon’s region from a longer label, because visual grouping can keep a node understandable as its text grows.
strategic_value: A repeatable colored icon block can preserve IBM diagram structure while accommodating additional description.
demonstration: A pale-blue large node contains a white person icon in a solid blue block at upper left, a multiline label at right and an inset Child node below. Its captions identify the container as expanded for nesting and state that the color block does not expand.
practical_value: Use the color-block large-node treatment to distinguish the icon region while accommodating longer labels and nested nodes.

content_islands.name: Node-type selector
content_islands.spec: Show Color block node selected after the outlined and side-bar options.

content_islands.name: Icon block
content_islands.spec: Place the white person icon within the solid blue left compartment.

content_islands.name: Label region
content_islands.spec: Set the expanded-for-nesting label and the Color block does not expand explanation to the right of the icon block.

content_islands.name: Nested node
content_islands.spec: Place a white outlined Child node inside the lower part of the expanded pale-blue container.

reference_purposes.Application: The paused specimen shows a nested Child node within the expanded container; the visible caption states that the color block does not expand.
